get.description: Read a page of objects of a specified type in your HubSpot account. You can control the data returned by specifying the properties you want to include in the response. This endpoint supports pagination and allows you to retrieve associated object IDs and archived records.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

post.description: Create a CRM object with the specified properties and return a copy of the object, including its ID. This endpoint is useful for adding new objects to your CRM system, allowing you to define the properties of the object upon creation.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Archive a batch of CRM objects identified by their IDs. This endpoint is useful for moving multiple objects to the recycling bin in a single request, streamlining the process of managing large datasets.

Create a batch of CRM objects with the specified properties. This endpoint allows you to create multiple objects in a single request, which can be useful for efficiently adding large datasets to your HubSpot account. The response includes a copy of each created object, including their IDs.

Retrieve a batch of CRM objects by their internal IDs or unique property values. This endpoint is useful for fetching multiple objects in a single request, which can help optimize performance and reduce the number of API calls needed. You can specify whether to include archived objects in the results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

post.description: Update a batch of CRM objects in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify multiple objects at once by providing their details in the request body. It is useful for bulk updates where you need to change properties of several objects simultaneously.

Create or update a batch of CRM objects by their unique property values. This endpoint allows you to efficiently manage multiple objects in a single request, ensuring that existing objects are updated while new ones are created. It is useful for synchronizing data with external systems or maintaining up-to-date records in your HubSpot account.

Permanently delete a contact and all associated content to comply with GDPR regulations. This endpoint allows you to specify the contact by email using the optional 'idProperty' set to 'email'. If the email address is not found, it will be added to a blocklist to prevent future use.

Merge two CRM objects of the same type in your HubSpot account. This operation combines the properties and associations of the specified objects into a single object, identified by the primary object ID.

Search for CRM objects of a specified type using various filters and criteria. This endpoint allows you to perform complex searches by specifying filter groups, properties, and sorting options. It is useful for retrieving specific objects based on detailed search parameters.

get.description: Read an object identified by `objectId`. The `objectId` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query parameter. You can control what is returned via the `properties` query parameter. This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about a specific CRM object, including its properties, associations, and history.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: properties

delete.description: Move an object identified by `{objectId}` to the recycling bin. This operation allows you to archive a specific CRM object by its ID, effectively removing it from active use while retaining it in the system for potential future restoration.

patch.description: Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{objectId}`. `{objectId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type
